observed.caption: Elevated wide view of a dense city center with clustered high-rise buildings under a pale blue sky with scattered clouds.
observed.description: The photo shows an elevated panoramic view over a dense urban area. In the immediate foreground a weathered concrete rooftop parapet runs across the bottom edge. Below and beyond are numerous high-rise and mid-rise buildings with varied facades including yellow-tinted glass, brown grid windows, dark reflective glass, and white concrete, interspersed with patches of green trees and narrow streets with small parked vehicles. A tall dark glass tower stands near the center behind two yellow-glass buildings, with additional mid-rise clusters extending to the left and low-rise sprawl stretching to a hazy horizon. The upper half is pale blue sky with a few small white and sunlit clouds and warm golden light casting long shadows and illuminating building sides.
